text:
A thousand times I keep silent, though longing to split heaven with cries, and try to give my tongue voice, seeing it lie in deathly silence;


thought runs in my soul like a courier, loud and tearful from pain, a new Orpheus in death's shadow.


Memory or hope finds no sweet image by which will may live secure:


all in me is curse, delayed death, inconsolable weeping, Heaven's disdain, fortune's error.

translation.title: A Thousand Times I Keep Silent, Though I Long to Break
